{{Quote|The Corellian Sector is made up of a couple of dozen star systems, but the most important star system in the sector is the Corellian star system. And the most important planet in the Corellian star system in the Corellian Sector is Corellia.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="AaC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
The '''Corellian system''', also known as the '''Corellia system''', the most important in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], contained five inhabited [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] collectively referred to as the [[Five Brothers/Legends|Five Brothers]]. [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]], [[Drall (planet)|Drall]], [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], and [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]] were all believed to have been transported through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to their orbits by the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]], utilizing the ancient [[Centerpoint Station]], in around [[100,000 BBY/Legends|100,000 BBY]]. All five planets contained an enormous [[planetary repulsor]] buried beneath the surface. Corellia, Selonia, and Drall orbited the [[Star system/Legends|system]] [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Corell/Legends|Corell]], while Talus and Tralus were in the unusual position of [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] each other, while the dual-planet system orbited Corell. At the point where Talus and Tralus's gravity canceled out lay Centerpoint Station. The Corellian system was part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of the Galaxy, and it is probable that all the Five Brothers were [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founders]].
